questions_for_author.question: sexlab_none_rape.yaml eligibility requires ostim_player == 1 while sexlab_sex2 parents require == 0. Is SexLab_Start_Rape intentionally OStim-only (SexLab mode uses only fixed-role sex2_rape_*)?
Actor JSON always emits arousal=-1; 0550 gates on arousal > 90/95/99 never fire. Populate from SLA/SLSO/DOM, or remove/replace those prompt branches?
When the 10-scene pool is full, GetSceneInactive always rebinds sl_scene_generic (can overwrite a live generic). Prefer refuse new scenes, expand pool, or queue?
AnimationEnd tentacles path calls GetIsOrgasming for every position (appends " is orgasming." + increments totals). Intentional flavor, or restrict to expected orgasmers?
CreateCreator returns the slot even when Setup early-outs without STATUS_ACTIVE. Should CreateCreator return None on Setup failure?

finding.problem: Outfit decorator/helper advertise "dresses"/"undresses", but Change_Outfit only remaps "take off"→undress and "put on"→dress. Any other token (including "dresses") falls into the else strip branch. LLM "put clothes on" via the action can strip instead.
finding.evidence: Decorators Outfit_Options: options = "undresses" or "dresses". Helper: [style] {{option}}. Actions Change_Outfit L265-298: only take off/put on remapped; else → StripActor.
finding.fix: Accept dresses/undresses (and dress/undress) in Change_Outfit, and/or change Outfit_Options + helper to emit put on / take off. Only strip when how normalizes to undress.
finding.assumptions: Helper output is passed through as the how parameter unchanged.

finding.problem: UpdateActor STATUS_ACTIVE branch calls JMap.setStr(obj, "notice_level", "active") before int obj = position_objs[i]. Locals default to 0, so this writes JMap handle 0 — notice_level never becomes "active" on the stable-actor AlignActors path.
finding.evidence: L647-651: elseif STATUS_ACTIVE → setStr(obj,...); then int obj = position_objs[i].
finding.fix: Assign obj = position_objs[i] before the if/elseif, or call JMap.setStr(position_objs[i], ...).
finding.assumptions: Papyrus uninitialized int locals are 0; JMap.setStr(0,...) is a no-op/invalid.

finding.problem: When all 10 pool scenes are busy, GetSceneInactive always returns sl_scene_generic and SetThread without checking whether generic already serves another live thread. Concurrent 11th+ scenes can corrupt each other's thread pointer, JSON, orgasm stash, and Release. Amplifies: Scene.Release skips UnsetThread_scene when is_generic (L452-455), leaving stale thread_scene[tid] → generic until a later mismatch force-Release.
finding.evidence: Manager L398-406: always bind generic. Scene Release L452-455: UnsetThread_scene only if !is_generic.
finding.fix: Per Q3: if generic.GetThreadActive(), refuse allocate / expand pool / queue. Always UnsetThread_scene(thread.tid) on Release including generic.
finding.assumptions: sl_scene_generic is a single Scene instance; SetThread replaces prior thread binding.

finding.problem: Debug dumps leak into LLM final instructions: raw UUID/speaker dumps inside the actor loop and a bare {{speaker}} after the thread loop.
finding.fix: Delete both dump lines (keep structured prose rules that follow).
finding.assumptions: Inja object dump is visible to the model as text.

finding.problem: Multi-thread loop unconditionally sets speaker.notice_level = _notice_level after every thread. After matching the speaker in thread N (active=true, level 2), a later thread still overwrites notice_level with that thread's LOS-only level (often 0/1). Gate speaker.notice_level > 1 can then fail while speaker.active stays true.
finding.evidence: L22-61: for each thread, actor match sets active; L49 always assigns notice_level; L64 gates on notice_level > 1.
finding.fix: Only update speaker.notice_level when this thread matched the speaker, or max() with prior / skip overwrite when speaker.active.
finding.assumptions: Inja {% set speaker.notice_level %} mutates the shared speaker map across loop iterations.

finding.problem: SetActor always writes arousal=-1 and never updates it. 0550 branches on arousal > 90/95/99 are dead. Dom EnrichActorObjForJson also defaults missing arousal to -1.
finding.evidence: Scene L581: JMap.setInt(obj,"arousal", -1) 0550 L41-47: if speaker.arousal > 99 / 95 / 90 Manager EnrichActorObjForJson L938-939
finding.fix: Per Q2: populate from SLA faction / SLSO / Dom, or remove/replace the 0550 arousal blocks.
finding.assumptions: No other writer updates actor arousal after SetActor in the SexLab path.

finding.problem: Eligibility requires SkyrimNet_SexLab_ostim_player == 1. SexLab category parents require == 0. In SexLab framework mode this dynamic-victim rape action never qualifies.
finding.evidence: sexlab_none_rape.yaml L35-39 expectedValue: 1 vs sexlab_sex2_.yaml / sex3 parents expectedValue: 0.
finding.fix: Per Q1: if SexLab mode should use it, change to == 0 (or drop OStim gate). If OStim-only, document in guides/Actions.md and do not change eligibility.
finding.assumptions: ostim_player global is 0 for SexLab MCM mode and 1 for OStim player mode.

finding.problem: Undress path always sets success=True even when StripActor returns empty (already nude / failed). Narration/RegisterEvent still fires as if clothing changed. Dress path correctly requires forms.
finding.evidence: L296-298: StripActor then success = True unconditionally.
finding.fix: Set success from forms.length > 0 (or SexLab result), same as dress.

finding.problem: Static intent value "refused" is interpolated by StartScene_Refused_Two into "... refused to allow {intent} by ...", producing "refused to allow refused by ...". punish_refused correctly uses intent value "punish".
finding.evidence: Actions L154: msg = ... " refused to allow "+intent+" by " sex2/comfort/nonsexual refused YAML intent value: refused
finding.fix: Set intent to a noun phrase matching the category (sexual activities / physically comforting / showing affection), matching punish_refused's pattern.

finding.problem: Tentacles AnimationEnd calls GetIsOrgasming for every position, appending " is orgasming." and incrementing totals for all actors. Breaks multi-actor orgasm contract (non-orgasmers must not get that substring) and skews SeparateOrgasms afterglow.
finding.evidence: L1016-1022: HasTag("tentacles") then while positions GetIsOrgasming.
finding.fix: Per Q4: flavor-only tentacles line without per-actor GetIsOrgasming, or only call for actors that actually orgasm / are expected.

finding.problem: CreateCreator always returns the slot after Setup(), but Setup can early-return on failed links / empty actors without setting STATUS_ACTIVE. Callers may LockAllActorLock / StartScene on a half-initialized or empty creator (vacuous lock when num_actors == 0).
finding.evidence: Manager L177-179: Setup then return creators[i]. Creator Setup L144-150: early return without STATUS_ACTIVE (set only at L188).
finding.fix: Per Q5: Setup returns Bool; CreateCreator returns None if Setup fails. Callers already treat None.

finding.problem: method may be "kissing", but setting_name is always nonsexual_male_position_1 (empty speaking_modifiers). Menu path loads nonsexual_kissing (tags=kissing, speaking_modifiers=_kissing_). LLM kissing therefore misses _kissing_ prompt rules in 0050.
finding.evidence: comfort/nonsexual_general setting_name "nonsexual_male_position_1" Menu.psc ~207: setting_name = "nonsexual_kissing" when kissing selected 0050: contains(..., "_kissing_")
finding.fix: Dedicated kissing action with setting_name nonsexual_kissing, or map method kissing → that setting in Papyrus. At minimum document YAML kissing will not get _kissing_ mods.

finding.problem: Fixed-role TargetVictim/SpeakerVictim actions still expose dynamic direction giving|getting. StartScene_Event sets speaker_position from the victim role and ignores direction. Leftover param confuses the LLM and cannot change roles.
finding.evidence: Actions L210-214: victim branches set position before direction logic. Spanking already uses static direction "".
finding.fix: Make direction static value: "" (mirror spanking), or remove from descriptions.

finding.problem: Dom EnrichActorObjForJson omits speaking_modifiers[]. SexLab actors get the array; Dom-path speakers may miss contains(speaker.speaking_modifiers, ...) rules in 0050/0550.
finding.fix: Add empty JArray (or Dom-derived modifiers) in EnrichActorObjForJson.

finding.problem: Dual notice_level semantics: emitter uses strings "nothing"/"active"; prompts treat notice_level as int 0/1/2 and overwrite. Emitted string is unused for gating; docs that list both meanings are misleading. Couples with H2 (active string never written on AlignActors path).
finding.evidence: Scene L576-578 setStr notice_level; 0050 L19/49/64 numeric overwrite and gate.
finding.fix: Emit numeric 0/1/2 and have prompts trust JSON, or drop actor notice_level from export and keep prompt-local _notice_level only; update guides/Prompts.md.

finding.problem: Category parent PARAMS still advertise type (and nonsexual what) while leaf mappings and guides/Actions.md prefer Papyrus slot name method. Punish parent omits rape methods present as leaves. Parent option lists diverge from fucking vs giving leaf vocab.
finding.fix: Rename type→method in PARAMS; align option lists with leaves; extend punish PARAMS to cover rape leaves or document parent as spank/whip-only hint.

finding.problem: GetIsOrgasming "again" branch: after total_orgasms < 0 increment path, local total_orgasms stays -1 so if total_orgasms > 1 never runs. "again" only appears when an absolute count is passed.
finding.fix: Compare against GetTotalOrgasms(akActor) after update (or a local after increment).

finding.problem: Trace(func, msg, notification=False) invoked as Trace("...", true) — bool becomes msg string; notifications never fire for parse/save errors.
finding.fix: Trace("GetAnim_Info", "Parse error for "+fn, true) (same pattern for siblings).

finding.problem: Docs mention sexlab_none category, but there is no sexlab_none_.yaml and none_* executables omit customCategory (top-level utilities).
finding.fix: Add sexlab_none_.yaml + customCategory, or update guides/Actions.md to say uncategorized utilities.

finding.problem: Checkpoint still claims underscore-prefixed JSON keys (_actors/_activity/_options) and implies GetDescription/GetObj are the JSON consumer path. Truth: bare lowercase keys via ObjectToLowerCaseKeyJson; JSON is GetThreadJson/GetThreadsJson; GetDescription is prose.
finding.fix: Rewrite architecture detail to bare lowercase + note underscores are for protocol values only; document prose vs JSON export paths. (Also applied in review-checkout.xml this pass.)

finding.problem: StartScene_Nonconsensual_Three exists but no action YAML binds it. Only consensual three + nonsexual three.
finding.fix: Add leaves if threesome assault is desired; otherwise leave as unused API (informational).
